name: Secondary Polyarteritis Nodosa
aliases: Polyarteritis Nodosa associated with underlying disease

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: American College of Rheumatology 1990 Criteria for Polyarteritis Nodosa

criteria.description: Angiographic demonstration of aneurysms or occlusions of visceral arteries not due to other causes
Biopsy of small- or medium-sized artery containing polymorphonuclear cells showing necrotizing arteritis
Presence of an underlying disease known to cause secondary PAN (e.g., hepatitis B infection, connective tissue disease)
Systemic symptoms such as weight loss, fever, and malaise with evidence of organ ischemia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of angiographic or histopathologic evidence of necrotizing arteritis plus clinical features consistent with PAN in the context of an underlying disease
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Secondary PAN is distinguished from primary PAN by the presence of an associated underlying condition such as hepatitis B or autoimmune diseases.

searchTerms: inflammation of medium arteries causing tissue death

pathognomonic.notes: Peripheral nerve ischemia due to vasculitis

searchTerms: general symptoms like fever and weight loss
feeling unwell with fever and tiredness

common.symptomName: Hypertension secondary to renal artery involvement
searchTerms: high blood pressure from kidney artery
secondary high blood pressure from kidneys

common.notes: Inflammation of vessel walls in muscles and joints

common.symptomName: Abdominal pain due to mesenteric ischemia
searchTerms: belly pain from poor blood flow
abdominal pain due to low intestine blood supply

occasional.notes: Due to vascular leakage or renal involvement

searchTerms: nerve damage without single nerve loss

rare.notes: Rare in PAN, more common in other vasculitides

searchTerms: brain involvement with stroke or seizures

laboratory: Hepatitis B surface antigen positivity in secondary PAN
imaging: Angiography showing microaneurysms and stenoses in medium-sized arteries
CT or MRI angiography for vessel assessment
genetic: No specific genetic markers identified for secondary PAN
other: Biopsy of affected tissue showing necrotizing arteritis with fibrinoid necrosis

redFlags: Acute mesenteric ischemia with severe abdominal pain
Mononeuritis multiplex with progressive neurological deficits
references: Jennette JC, Falk RJ, Bacon PA, et al. 2012 Revised International Chapel Hill Consensus Conference Nomenclature of Vasculitides. Arthritis Rheum. 2013 Jan;65(1):1-11.
